notes.title: Greetings, fellow spellcasters!✨
notes.notes:
We’ve looked into your reviews and comments, and we see that everyone enjoys different characters in 
our games - which is great, and that’s why we try to bring you a wide arrangement of them, so everyone 
can find their favourite! It's astonishing to see how our cast resonates with unique people in unique 
ways - there’s some magic involved, isn’t it?

While we prepare Chapter 3 for you, tell us, who bewitched your hearts?🔮
Who do you like the most in Chapters 1&2? And of course, if anyone left you feeling less enchanted, 
let us know as well! We want to know what you think of the characters.
Your honest and open feedback would help us brew up an even more intriguing potion in the future!

notes.title: Game Update Highlights 🧙‍♂️✨
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Exciting news! Our latest game update is now live, bringing some game-changing features to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a quick rundown of what's new:
[list]
[*] Quest for Elixir Mastery: Dive into a mandatory quest that guides you through the intricacies of obtaining and selling elixirs. Sharpen your alchemical skills and reap the rewards!

[*] Resolution Roadblock Resolved: We've squashed a pesky bug that was causing difficulties accessing specific locations at certain screen resolutions. Seamless exploration awaits!
[/list]
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these issues and appreciate your patience. With these improvements, we're confident your gaming adventures will be smoother than ever.

P.S. Boost your coin collection by crafting potions in the Alchemy class and selling them at Cassandra's store.

Happy gaming!

Sincerely, The Development Team 🎮🌟

notes.title: 🐞 Bug Bounty Board: Help Us Squash the Magic!
notes.notes: Join the Bug Bounty Board to be a hero of the magical realm! Report and discuss any glitches or bugs you encounter, helping us ensure a seamless and enchanting gaming experience for all. Your insights are our secret weapon against pesky bugs!

notes.title: Enchantment Exchange: Share Your Thoughts! 🌟💬 Let's Craft Magic Together!
notes.notes: Connect with fellow enchanters here! Share your thoughts, suggestions, and magical experiences with our game. Your feedback is the potion that makes our magic stronger!

notes.title: Dive into the Magic and Share Your Wizardry Tales!
notes.notes:
Hello, guys!

We've poured our hearts and magic into creating something truly special, and we're thrilled to announce that our hard work has finally paid off – our game is now live on Steam! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752187/dfe813621f042b612f9fc0d072a36d7c77f0e6d9.jpg[/img]
We've crafted every spell, puzzle, and adventure with passion, and we hope it brings joy and enchantment to all who play. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so if you have any thoughts, suggestions, or just want to share your magical experiences, feel free to reach out! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44752187/1b3610be7a17a6dae17456c73249df965bb4f91f.jpg[/img]
Thank you for being part of this magical journey with us. Grab your wands, dive into the mystical realm of our game, and let the adventures begin!
